summary: Frontend-only e2e testing of new 'Assistente IA' module. All flows PASS: nav link (data-testid='nav-assistente') opens /app/assistente; Conversa tab creates new sessions and lists them; chat replies work for GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6 AND Gemini 3 Flash; conversation persists across session switches; image mode returns a data: base64 ; PDF tab generates a styled DocPreview with title, sections, items table and gold TOTAL for 'proposta'; download-pdf-btn triggers a jsPDF .save() (file downloaded); print-pdf-btn opens a print window (about:blank popup). No uncaught console/pageerror errors captured during the whole run.
action_items: Optional cleanup: 4 test ai_sessions were left in the DB for the admin user (titles include 'Nova conversa' with pong/ok claude/ok gemini messages and one image-gen session). Main agent may delete them from Mongo ai_sessions collection filtered by owner=admin if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: Assistente.jsx: printPdf uses node.outerHTML in a new window without copying computed CSS from the SPA context. Because the DocPreview template relies entirely on inline styles this currently prints correctly, but any future refactor to Tailwind classes will break the print view. Consider inlining styles or explicitly loading a print stylesheet.

downloadPdf paginates by rendering the same full-page image N times and shifting its y offset; this works but produces oversized PDFs (~1-2MB per page) and can crop content across the page break. A future improvement is html2pdf's paged mode or splitting per section.
Loading 'openSession' does not surface errors to the user (silent await); if the network fails the messages panel silently stays with the previous content. Consider try/catch + toast.
loadSessions and openSession use .catch(() => {}) swallowing errors — hides real failures during debugging.
No pagination for /ai/sessions — long-time users may hit large lists. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created several ai_sessions during testing (chat + image + pdf). Not cleaned up because DELETE endpoint requires per-session UI clicks; low-priority residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 acceptance criteria for Assistente IA pass on the deployed preview URL. If retest is requested, credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md still valid. The PDF download uses Playwright's expect_download() which works via jsPDF's Blob save. AI responses take 3-25s so keep 30-60s waits per step.
